cases.uiLocation: ProjectsPage — header, Create button, Recent list
cases.title: Licensed user opens the Projects workspace
cases.what: A user with the thinkspace-projects license opens the Projects module and sees the main layout without errors.
cases.steps:
1. Sign in.
2. Navigate to /thinkspace/projects.
3. Confirm Projects heading and Create button are visible.
4. Confirm page is not redirected to /403.
cases.expected: Projects workspace loads successfully.

cases.workflowStep: Create modal → fill required fields → Save Draft
cases.title: Save a new project as Draft
cases.what: User creates a project request with required fields and saves as draft.
cases.steps:
1. Open Create modal.
2. Fill title, company, owner.
3. Click Save Draft.
4. Verify toast and list badge shows Draft.
cases.expected: Project is saved with Draft workflow stage.

cases.workflowStep: Submit Request without statutory and cost ≤ ₹500k
cases.title: Submit project enters Under Review
cases.what: Standard submit sets workflow to Under Review when no finance/statutory triggers apply.
cases.steps:
1. Create project with low cost.
2. Submit Request.
3. Verify workflow badge Under Review.
cases.expected: Project workflow stage is Under Review.

cases.uiLocation: Create modal — Estimated Cost, Submit Request
cases.title: High-cost submit enters Finance Review
cases.what: Projects above ₹500k route to Finance Review on submit.
cases.steps:
1. Set estimated cost to 600000.
2. Submit Request.
3. Verify Finance Review badge and tracker stage.
cases.expected: Project workflow stage is Finance Review.

cases.uiLocation: Create modal — Statutory approvals, Submit Request
cases.title: Statutory submit enters Compliance Review
cases.what: When statutory approval is required and cost is not high, submit routes to Compliance Review.
cases.steps:
1. Enable Statutory Approval Required.
2. Enable legal/compliance apps with remarks.
3. Submit Request.
4. Verify Compliance Review.
cases.expected: Project workflow stage is Compliance Review.

cases.workflowStep: Enable statutory master + sub-checkboxes with remarks
cases.title: Configure statutory approval checkboxes and remarks
cases.what: User enables statutory flag and individual legal/compliance/finance/management apps with remarks.
cases.steps:
1. Open create modal.
2. Check Statutory Approval Required.
3. Enable legal and compliance with remarks.
4. Save Draft.
5. Open detail Overview and verify display.
cases.expected: Statutory configuration persists and displays in detail.

cases.workflowStep: Add Action → fill name/owner → Save Action
cases.title: Add action item to project form table
cases.what: User adds an inline action item before saving the project.
cases.steps:
1. Click Add Action.
2. Fill Action Name and Owner.
3. Save Action.
4. Verify row in table.
cases.expected: Action item appears in the form table.

cases.uiLocation: Create modal submit → detail Actions tab
cases.title: Submit converts action items to linked tasks
cases.what: On non-Draft submit, backend converts unconverted action items to Thinkspace tasks.
cases.steps:
1. Add action item.
2. Submit Request.
3. Open detail Actions tab.
4. Verify task appears.
cases.expected: Action item is converted to a Thinkspace task.

cases.uiLocation: Detail modal — Overview, Actions, Milestones, Gantt, Comments
cases.title: Open project detail and switch tabs
cases.what: User opens detail modal and navigates across planning tabs.
cases.steps:
1. Click a project card.
2. Verify Overview tab.
3. Switch to Actions, Milestones, Comments tabs.
cases.expected: Detail modal tabs are accessible.

cases.workflowStep: Edit draft → update title → Save Draft
cases.title: Edit an existing draft project
cases.what: User edits a draft project from the list and saves changes.
cases.steps:
1. Create draft.
2. Click Edit.
3. Change title.
4. Save Draft.
5. Verify updated title in list.
cases.expected: Draft project is updated successfully.

cases.title: Delete a project from the list
cases.what: User deletes a project after confirming the dialog.
cases.steps:
1. Create draft.
2. Click Delete.
3. Confirm.
4. Verify project removed from list.
cases.expected: Project is soft-deleted and removed from Recent list.

cases.workflowStep: Verify compact stage pills on list card
cases.title: Workflow tracker reflects statutory and finance stages
cases.what: List card shows conditional Finance and Statutory stages in the tracker.
cases.steps:
1. Submit statutory project.
2. Verify Statutory / Compliance Approval pill on card.
cases.expected: Workflow tracker includes statutory compliance stage.

cases.workflowStep: Create, edit, and delete milestone in detail modal
cases.title: Milestone CRUD with status and dates
cases.what: User creates a milestone with title, status, and dates; edits it; then deletes it.
cases.steps:
1. Open draft detail → Milestones.
2. Add milestone (Active, start/end dates).
3. Edit title and status.
4. Delete milestone with confirm.
cases.expected: Milestone is created, updated, and deleted successfully.

cases.workflowStep: Post comment in Comments & Activity Log
cases.title: Post comment appears in activity log
cases.what: User posts a comment from the detail modal and sees it in the activity log.
cases.steps:
1. Open draft detail → Comments.
2. Verify empty state.
3. Type comment → Post Comment.
4. Verify Comment Added toast and log entry.
cases.expected: Comment is saved and displayed in the activity log.

cases.title: Guest user is redirected to login
cases.what: Unauthenticated users cannot access the Projects module.
cases.steps:
1. Open /thinkspace/projects without auth.
2. Expect redirect to login.
cases.expected: User is redirected to login.

cases.workflowStep: Open create modal without required fields
cases.uiLocation: Create modal — Save Draft / Submit disabled
cases.title: Save buttons disabled when required fields missing
cases.what: Title, company, and owner are required before save buttons enable.
cases.steps:
1. Open Create.
2. Clear title.
3. Verify Save Draft and Submit Request disabled.
cases.expected: User cannot save without required fields.

cases.workflowStep: Save Action without name or owner
cases.uiLocation: Create modal — Action items Save Action
cases.title: Action item validation requires name and owner
cases.what: Saving an action item without name or owner shows validation toast.
cases.steps:
1. Open Add Action form.
2. Click Save Action without filling fields.
3. Expect Validation Error toast.
cases.expected: Action item is not saved without required fields.

cases.title: Cancel create does not save project
cases.what: Cancelling the create modal discards the form without creating a project.
cases.steps:
1. Fill title and owner.
2. Click Cancel.
3. Verify project not in list.
cases.expected: No project is created after cancel.

cases.title: Delete cancelled keeps project in list
cases.what: Dismissing the delete confirmation leaves the project unchanged.
cases.steps:
1. Create draft.
2. Click Delete.
3. Dismiss confirm dialog.
4. Project still in list.
cases.expected: Project remains after cancelled delete.

cases.title: Post Comment disabled when textarea empty
cases.what: Post Comment button stays disabled until the user enters text.
cases.steps:
1. Open draft detail → Comments.
2. Verify Post Comment disabled with empty textarea.
cases.expected: User cannot post an empty comment.

cases.title: Save Milestone disabled when title empty
cases.what: Save Milestone button is disabled until a milestone title is entered.
cases.steps:
1. Open Add Milestone form.
2. Verify Save Milestone disabled.
cases.expected: User cannot save a milestone without a title.

cases.title: Cancel milestone form does not save
cases.what: Cancelling the milestone form closes it without adding a row.
cases.steps:
1. Open Add Milestone.
2. Fill title.
3. Click Cancel.
4. Verify no milestone row.
cases.expected: Milestone is not created after cancel.
